# Job 6 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Job 6 (30 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.6 — "juice of the mallow" vs. "white of an egg"
- **LOGOS:** "juice of the mallow" / **PNEUMA:** "white of an egg"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "juice of the mallow" — Hebrew *chalamut* is botanically uncertain; traditional identification as mallow preferred over Talmudic "egg-white."

---

## V.14 — Syntax of kindness to a friend
- **LOGOS:** "He who withholds kindness from a friend forsakes the fear of the Almighty" / **PNEUMA:** "A despairing person deserves loyalty from his friends, even if he has abandoned the fear of the Almighty"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** Follows LOGOS — withholding kindness is the failure, not Job's piety.

---

## V.21 — "become nothing"
- **LOGOS:** "you have now become nothing" / **PNEUMA:** "That is what you have become to me — nothing"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "you have now become nothing" — the Hebrew is starkly absolute; no qualifier needed.

---
*— SOPHIA*
